headline: Maryville and Drury pull level at the top
dek: Maryville's win over Missouri S&T on Saturday, and Drury's at Lewis the same afternoon, leave the pair level at the top with neither beaten in conference play; Quincy's goalless draw with William Jewell dropped them below both. Maryville's season reads seven wins, one draw and two defeats, twenty-eight goals scored and twelve conceded.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Maryville's twenty-eight goals are more than Lewis, Upper Iowa and William Jewell have scored between them, three programmes that share the foot of the chart.

wire.line: Lincoln are the last side in the conference without a defeat, and they got there by beating Southwest Baptist.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Lincoln remain the only programme in the conference yet to lose: four wins and three draws, thirteen goals scored and six conceded, the most recent win coming at Rockhurst.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Missouri S&T have still not drawn a match this season: six wins and three defeats, twenty goals scored and eleven conceded, the third defeat coming at Maryville on Saturday.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Indianapolis have drawn four matches, as many as they have won, the latest at home to Southwest Baptist on Sunday; they have conceded nine goals all season.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Truman have scored fifteen goals and conceded eighteen, and Jacob Panagos has nine of the fifteen from twenty-two shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Asgrimur Vidisson has made forty-two saves for Maryville and conceded ten, a save percentage of .808.

last_match.line: Indianapolis have now drawn as many matches as they have won; Southwest Baptist are still without an away win in conference play.

next_match.line: Drury have yet to lose in conference play; Missouri S&T have not drawn a match all season.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
